issue.title: command_line PNG snapshots drift or time out on clean HEAD after the ':'/';' key flip
issue.description:
The `test_ace_png_snapshots_command_line.py` PNG tests fail in the full visual lane and two of them fail on a clean HEAD worktree (55936f429, no local diff) in a focused run:

- `test_command_line_typed_ghost_png_snapshot[size0-command_line_typed_ghost_120x40]`: `ACE PNG snapshot mismatch` against the committed golden, on both clean HEAD runs (deterministic drift; the golden predates `c83e3bd91`, which flipped the command-line and palette keys to `:` and `;`).
- `test_command_line_empty_state_png_snapshot[size0-command_line_empty_state_120x40]`: `wait_for() timed out after 15.0s` in the seeded-panel setup.

In the full 13-worker `just fix-tui-screenshots` run, 8 of the 9 command-line nodes failed (convergence timeouts in `_seeded_panel` and golden mismatches), so the run ended `partial`. The goldens were left untouched by the sase-17d.10.1.4 tale: `command_line_*` and `command_palette_default*` belong to the command-line/palette owner (`c83e3bd91`).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The golden mismatch reproduced on both clean-HEAD runs and again in the full lane after three recover attempts; the golden predates the c83e3bd91 key flip. Companion node with a setup timeout: test_command_line_empty_state_png_snapshot[size0-command_line_empty_state_120x40].

evidence.note: Independent repro by sase-18g.land: a full just fix-tui-screenshots run at eb6407355 regenerated 13 command_line_*.png goldens plus command_palette_default_120x40 with completion-popup/footer drift (e.g. command_line_empty now shows a recent-command popup and '441 commands' footer), and test_command_line_block_expanded / test_command_line_empty_state failed. Those goldens were reverted from the sase-18g landing as out of scope.

Proposed by sase-17m.5.1.5 note #2 (epic sase-17m.5.1 land): in its full just fix-tui-screenshots run at ~e9ba5b708 parent, tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_command_line.py lost up to 8 nodes (churning set) to pending_workers=_load 30s convergence timeouts with zero pixel drift, reproducing identically on the clean base tree; not caused by the agent-session rename.

payload.entry: Owned by the sase-17x.13 land agent's follow-up plan (parent sase-17x.13): at master ea130c678 all 18 command_line PNG tests now pass in 12s (the visual _open_panel no-ops the grammar loader since 3c6e8f04d, so the _load timeouts are gone), but 16 command_line_* goldens drift (updated=16) because chrome-layout (403586e27) and completion-fixes were never regenerated. The follow-up plan's goldens phase regenerates them and should close this bead.

Resolved by epic sase-17x.13.10. Phase sase-17x.13.10.6 (9518b31df) regenerated all 18 command_line_* goldens: block_expanded, block_selected, completion_popup_160x40, declined, denied, doc_peek_160x40, earlier_divider, empty, empty_state, error, foreground, help, history_search, indexing, running, submit_failed, success, typed_ghost (120x40 unless noted). It also regenerated the Command Line onboarding goldens (agents_onboarding, agents_onboarding_no_plugins, changespecs_onboarding, changespecs_onboarding_no_match) and help_guide_agents. The land agent then removed the two remaining nondeterminism sources and regenerated again. empty_state's RECENT rows tied on one last_used second and were stamped in host time rather than the configured zone. The one-time palette tip reached the hint row from an off-thread worker, so 12 goldens showed it or not by timing; the visual _open_panel now pins it as already shown. Verified: the command_line PNG file passes 3/3 consecutive check runs (18 unchanged), and a full just test-visual shows no command_line drift and no setup timeouts.
